compiled:
📰 General

Xi Jinping Dominates Pacific Summit as Trump Remains Absent in Seoul •

Leaders from across the Pacific region, including Chinese President Xi Jinping, convened in South Korea for a significant summit. The summit focused on strengthening economic ties and security cooperation within the region. Notably, US President Donald Trump did not attend the event, departing South Korea prior to its commencement. The absence of the former president has drawn attention to shifting geopolitical dynamics within the Pacific.

🌍 World

King Charles III Removes Prince Andrew From Royal Family, Evicts Him •

King Charles III has formally removed his brother, Prince Andrew, from his remaining royal titles and has ordered him to vacate Buckingham Palace. The palace announced the decision in a statement released on Thursday, citing the ongoing public scrutiny surrounding Andrew’s past. This action follows a series of controversies involving the Duke, including allegations of sexual assault. The move represents a significant distancing between the two brothers within the British monarchy.

🦅 US

Gable Steveson Dominates Dirty Boxing Debut, Eyes UFC Opportunity •

Gable Steveson secured a decisive victory in his debut at the DBX 4 event in Nashville, defeating Billy Swanson in just 15 seconds. The Olympic gold medalist showcased striking prowess, demonstrating a significant evolution in his fighting style. Following the impressive performance, Steveson reportedly approached UFC representatives expressing interest in a potential move to the promotion. This victory further solidifies Steveson’s transition into the Dirty Boxing realm and fuels speculation about his future in mixed martial arts.

💰 Business

OpenAI’s Billion-Dollar Growth Fueled by Complex, Circular Funding Deals •

OpenAI’s rapid expansion is largely attributed to a novel approach to securing funding, utilizing intricate and recurring deals with investors. The company employs a system where investments are repeatedly rolled over, allowing them to maintain a constant influx of capital. These “circular deals” – often involving multiple rounds of investment within a short timeframe – have enabled OpenAI to rapidly scale its operations and develop advanced AI models. Altman emphasizes that these financial arrangements are as crucial to the company’s success as the underlying technology itself. This strategy has allowed OpenAI to bypass traditional venture capital timelines and maintain momentum.

💻 Technology

Anker Headphones See Massive Black Friday Discount, Prices Plummet Below $30 •

Anker’s Open Ear headphones are experiencing a significant Black Friday sale, offering a 53% discount on the retail price. The reduction brings the headphones down to nearly $30, making them a highly accessible option for consumers. This sale is notable because Anker has established a direct retail partnership with Apple, indicating confidence in the product’s quality and design. The headphones are currently available for purchase through Anker’s website and select Apple Stores.

🎭 Entertainment

“IT: Welcome to Derry” Premiere Shatters Expectations with Massive U.S. Viewership •

The HBO premiere of “IT: Welcome to Derry” garnered significant attention, drawing 5.7 million U.S. viewers across HBO and HBO Max within its first three days. The prequel series debuted on October 26th and immediately established a strong audience. Initial viewership figures surpassed expectations, indicating considerable interest in the continuation of the “IT” story. Warner Bros. data confirms the impressive launch numbers for the new series.

🏅 Sports

Traylor Slams Tulane Coach and QB Following Dominant UTSA Victory •

Following UTSA’s decisive 44-20 victory over Tulane on Thursday, head coach Jeff Traylor expressed significant dissatisfaction with comments made by Green Wave coach Jon Sumrall and quarterback Jake Retzlaff. Sumrall had reportedly questioned UTSA’s preparation and effort prior to the game, prompting Traylor’s response. Traylor stated that his team felt “extremely disrespected” by the remarks. The win improved UTSA’s record to 6-1, while Tulane fell to 5-2.

🔬 Science

NASA’s Perseverance Rover Spotted – Did It Find a 1984 Pontiac Fiero? •

Recent images released by NASA’s Perseverance rover have sparked widespread speculation online. A claim emerged suggesting the rover captured an image of a severely damaged 1984 Pontiac Fiero equipped with a rocket engine. The claim originated from a social media post interpreting a blurry object in one of the images. NASA has acknowledged the public interest but has stated that the object is likely a rock formation, not the vehicle suggested by the initial interpretation.

🩺 Health

Eyes Reveal Hidden Health Issues: Dietitian Identifies 9 Key Warning Signs •

A nutritionist has identified nine specific visual symptoms that can indicate underlying nutritional deficiencies or diseases. These signs, including changes in eye color, dryness, and blurred vision, are believed to be early indicators of conditions like anemia, vitamin A deficiency, and thyroid problems. Deepshikha Sharma suggests that addressing these visual cues through dietary adjustments and lifestyle changes can potentially mitigate the root cause. The expert emphasizes the importance of regular eye examinations alongside a focus on a balanced diet.
